title: Find Maximum Value in a Constrained Sequence
summary: Given an integer n, a 2D array of restrictions, and a diff array, construct a sequence of length n where a[0] is 0, all elements are non-negative, the absolute difference between consecutive elements does not exceed the corresponding diff value, and no element at a restricted index exceeds the specified maxVal.
statement: Given an integer n, a 2D array of restrictions, and a diff array, construct a sequence of length n where a[0] is 0, all elements are non-negative, the absolute difference between consecutive elements does not exceed the corresponding diff value, and no element at a restricted index exceeds the specified maxVal. The sequence should maximize the largest value while adhering to these constraints, and the largest value in the sequence is to be returned.
constraints: a[0]=0, every a[i] is nonnegative, and adjacent change is at most diff[i].
Each unique restricted index has an upper bound; maximize the largest attainable value.
hints: Every fixed upper bound creates a cone: position i is at most cap plus the path-distance from its anchor.
Initialize anchor caps, propagate reachable upper bounds forward, then backward using diff edge lengths.
The resulting array is the pointwise minimum of all cones; its largest entry is the answer.
The envelope obeys every adjacent bound and anchor cap, and choosing a equal to that envelope attains all its nonnegative values.
editorial: The envelope obeys every adjacent bound and anchor cap, and choosing a equal to that envelope attains all its nonnegative values.

tests.explanation: Propagating all bounds leaves a largest attainable value six.
The suffix can rise from the restriction to twelve at the final position.
